# Static export hosting rules (Universe / PreProd). Generated into out/.htaccess
# by scripts/export-api-snapshot.py - do not edit the output, edit this template.
RewriteEngine On

# Force HTTPS
RewriteCond %{HTTPS} !=on
RewriteRule ^ https://%{HTTP_HOST}%{REQUEST_URI} [L,R=301]

# Legacy referentiel slug redirects (mirrors next.config.ts redirects)
RewriteRule ^fr/referentiel/comment-lia-personnalise-un-parcours-de-formation/?$ /fr/referentiel/comment-lia-personnalise-et-adapte-un-parcours-de-formation/ [L,R=301]
RewriteRule ^en/referentiel/comment-lia-personnalise-un-parcours-de-formation/?$ /en/referentiel/comment-lia-personnalise-et-adapte-un-parcours-de-formation/ [L,R=301]

# API -> PHP proxy (same-origin; keeps forms + snapshot reads working)
RewriteRule ^api/(.*)$ proxy.php?url=api/$1 [L,QSA]

# Trailing-slash pretty URLs (Next.js trailingSlash export: /route/index.html)
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-f
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-d
RewriteRule ^(.*[^/])$ /$1/ [L,R=301]

ErrorDocument 404 /404.html
Options -Indexes

<IfModule mod_headers.c>
  Header always set X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"
  Header always set Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
  Header always set X-Frame-Options "SAMEORIGIN"
  Header always set Permissions-Policy "accelerometer=(), camera=(), geolocation=(), gyroscope=(), magnetometer=(), microphone=(), payment=(), usb=()"
</IfModule>
